note: The prepared photo eval for the label check, written before any run: real label photos, each looked at by hand, with the recall it must find (CPSC official recall images, public domain) or no recall (openly licensed photos of adapters no recall since January 2024 lists). scripts/label/eval-photos.ts reads each with Claude and scores it; it checks each image's SHA-256 against this file before reading, so the run reads the very pictures listed here. Not run yet.
scoring: A case with a recall is right when the label check names that recall settled by its code (the one match, or among recalls that share the code). A case with no recall is right when the check names no match. Model or UPC read exactly as looked at is counted beside it.
